dog.description_text: Hi! I just arrived! My foster pawrents are getting to know me and will add more info soon. Fox Face we are calling her Holly!! She is the sweetest little girl. She is doing great with potty training. No accidents! She is crate trained. Sleeps all night in her crate. Doing well on her leash continuing to learn. Likes kids.Very low key when meeting new people. Eats very well, no food guarding. Learning that toys are fun! Doing well with coming when called. Working on sit. Loves to lay next to you on the couch. Low energy and hasn’t barked yet! She has ears that are very expressive! If you are looking for the perfect little companion she is for you!They flap in the wind lol.ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
